description_en: Generates an HMAC message authentication code for a message by using a specified key
description_zh: 使用指定密钥为消息生成HMAC消息认证码
kebab_example: aliyun kms generate-mac --key-id key-hzz630494463ejqjx0000 --message VGhlIHF1aWNrIGJyb3duIGZveCBqdW1wcyBvdmVyIHRoZSBsYXp5IGRvZy4= --algorithm HMAC_SHA_256 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateMac

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify a key alias or a key Amazon Resource Name (ARN). For more information about aliases, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.
When you access a key that belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the key ARN. The format of a key ARN is `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
The data for which you want to generate a message authentication code.  

The value is Base64-encoded. For example, if the hexadecimal data is `[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`, the corresponding Base64-encoded value is `MTIzNA==`
parameters.help_zh:
待生成消息验证码的数据。  

使用Base64编码。例如：待生成消息验证码的十六进制内容为`[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`，则对应的Base64编码为`MTIzNA==`
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en:
The algorithm that is used to generate the message authentication code. Valid values vary based on the key specification:  

HMAC_SM3

HMAC_SHA_224

HMAC_SHA_256

HMAC_SHA_384

HMAC_SHA_512
parameters.help_zh:
生成消息验证码的算法。依据使用的密钥规格不同，可取值包括：  

HMAC_SM3

HMAC_SHA_224

HMAC_SHA_256

HMAC_SHA_384

HMAC_SHA_512
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable DryRun mode.

true: enabled
false (default): disabled

DryRun mode is used to test API calls and verify whether you have the required permissions on the corresponding resources and whether the request parameters are correctly configured. When DryRun mode is enabled, KMS always returns a failure and provides the failure reason. Failure reasons include:

DryRunOperationError: The request would succeed without the DryRun parameter.
ValidationError: The parameters specified in the request are invalid.
AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

KeyId.description_en:
The globally unique identifier of the customer master key (CMK).

If the KeyId parameter in the request uses a CMK alias, the response returns the CMK identifier that corresponds to the alias
KeyId.description_zh:
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。

如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是主密钥的别名，在响应中会返回别名对应的主密钥标识符

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
